Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Rötschreck is German.
Omega would be Greek.
Anthelios sounds Greek (anti + helios = the opposite of the sun)

Tortured Confession quotes Stalin:
To chase one's victim, to prepare one's plan minutely, to slake an implacable vengeance, and then to go to bed... There is nothing sweeter in the world.
Josef Stalin

Tatiana Stepanova is probably Russian in the cannon (but expected patronym should be Stepanovna)
Tatiana Romanov might be Russian (but the -ov patronym is more likely not to be Russian than to be - it should've been -ova)
Ilyana Ravidovich is also weird. It should've been Ilyana Ravidovna.

BBs of group 6 are of the Kiev circle - that might be regarded as "Russian" if you go back before '91. Volo has the orthodox church cross on his arm.
